source_contract.funding: realized event-time settlement against prior position; missing, unsupported, or incomplete funding blocks the affected candidate
source_contract.decision_clock: after close of completed 1h bar t; target applies to t->t+1
source_contract.turnover: kernel-owned one-way notional turnover on PRE_COST_EQUITY target weights, including terminal liquidation

forward_plan.plan: three exact frozen variants × 20 fixed single-asset panel members × baseline/stress

input_identity_rules: exact three candidate IDs and exact candidate-specific parameters
exact fixed 20-symbol order and source-universe digest from selection freeze
exact 2,161 hourly boundaries from SEALED_T0 through end
candidate-specific causal warmup from the existing input-bundle contract
bundle payload digest must recompute; asset coverage must be COMPLETE
no interpolation, forward fill, listing filter, liquidity filter, backfill, or dynamic universe

decision_reducer.PROMOTE: all integrity, stress aggregate, non-negative forward, asset breadth, concentration, cost-survival, and fixed-parameter identity gates pass; eligible only for a separately authorized next evidence tier
decision_reducer.ITERATE: reserved for a separately preregistered future contract; this complete-data implementation emits no ambiguous forward result
decision_reducer.KILL: any hard failure, non-finite result, unresolved coverage, identity violation, or inability to execute under frozen timing/source/benchmark/cost semantics
decision_reducer.selection_context: historical selection evidence is copied as context only; no forward result is confirmation of it

commands.pre_maturity_identity_only: python -m qntylab.project_context && python -m qntylab.research_ledger context && python -m qntylab.research_ledger doctor
commands.adjudication: authorized operator invokes qntylab.qnty_trading_results_sprint_v0_execution.adjudicate(as_of, canonical_freeze, bundles_by_candidate) only at/after 2026-11-08T19:00:00Z
commands.ledger: no QntyLab ledger append is performed by this readiness seam

authority_boundary: exploratory_only; no Qnty mutation, paper/live trading, capital authority, JH01, JFPV3, Router, State Snapshot, or Reactive Jigsaw
